purpose: Specify one project-native hash-bound manifest per formal Run so capture, verification, replay, failure, supersession and staleness are deterministic.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: A per-run manifest can bind hashes, seed, runtime and command for replay checks.
content_not_copied: No prompts, templates, examples or state machines copied.
project_specific_design: Extend the native Run contract and STALE graph.
Keep failed, partial and superseded records outside successful evidence.

inputs.name: formal_run_capture
inputs.description: Run ID; frozen input/raw-manifest hashes; executable, config, Git commit/tree; seed; allowlisted environment/dependency locks; argv, relative working directory and reproduction argv; times, exit, solver/model, outputs, metrics, failure/partial status and supersession.

inputs.name: verification_request
inputs.description: Run ID, manifest bytes, available bound artifacts and replay mode.

outputs.name: native_reproducibility_manifest
outputs.description: Versioned Run-owned manifest with verification result and mismatch codes; not separate state.

state_read_set: Formal Run, frozen hashes, Git, dependency/environment, artifacts and STALE graph.
schemas: Future additive native Run reproducibility contract; no parallel registry.

preconditions.statement: The Run ID exists and inputs come from registered native authorities.

postconditions.statement: Unchanged capture data reproduces canonical bytes, while every mismatch is recorded without converting failure to success.

invariants.statement: Exactly one current manifest binds each Run ID; historical versions are immutable.
SUCCESS requires all mandatory bindings and outputs verified; FAILED, PARTIAL, SUPERSEDED or STALE never counts as successful evidence.
Hashes cover canonical field values and artifact bytes.
No credential, key, password, browser state, hidden reasoning, raw trace or unnecessary private path is stored.
The same ordered logical capture yields byte-identical canonical JSON and hash.

hard_failures.statement: A mandatory binding is absent, malformed, ambiguous or unhashed.
A recomputed hash, Run/Git identity, output or replay result differs.
Replay environment or dependency lock differs from its fingerprint.
Sensitive or disallowed path content is detected.

algorithms.specification: CAPTURE canonicalizes allowlisted relative identifiers, argv, sorted maps and SHA-256 hashes. COMPLETE plus exit 0 and verified outputs may become SUCCESS. Nonzero exit is FAILED; missing/truncated output is PARTIAL; replacement makes the prior Run SUPERSEDED. VERIFY recomputes bindings before replay; mutation or identity/environment mismatch emits codes and STALE/REJECTED. REPLAY uses bound argv, directory, seed, config, dependencies and environment, then compares exit, outputs and metrics. Failed, partial, stale and superseded records stay queryable but are ineligible as successful evidence.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Use UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted object keys, preserved array order, no insignificant whitespace and SHA-256 lowercase hex.
Verify all bound bytes and identities before replay acceptance or downstream reuse.
Commands are argv arrays with project-relative directories; reject shell-only or private absolute-path records.

agent_responsibilities: Agents may supply capture data but cannot waive fields or mismatches; only the main agent associates verified manifests with formal state.

stale_propagation.statement: Changing any input, raw manifest, executable, config, Git tree/commit, seed, environment, dependency, command, output, metric or supersession binding marks the Run and dependents STALE until rebuilt from the earliest affected predecessor.

failure_modes.trigger: Missing binding, mutation, hash mismatch or environment mismatch.
failure_modes.consequence: Verification fails closed; the Run is not successful evidence and dependents become STALE.
failure_modes.recovery: Correct the authority and create a new versioned capture; never edit the old manifest.

failure_modes.trigger: Nonzero exit, interruption, missing output or supersession.
failure_modes.consequence: Record FAILED, PARTIAL or SUPERSEDED with emitted-output hashes and failure details; exclude it from successful evidence.
failure_modes.recovery: Preserve it and create a linked Run/attempt only if retry policy permits.

recovery_behavior.statement: Recovery creates a linked new Run or manifest version, re-verifies every binding and leaves failed/partial records unchanged.

audit_events.when: After capture, verification, replay, mismatch or supersession.

security_constraints: Use allowlisted local metadata; validation never executes captured commands.
Reject credentials, private keys, passwords, tokens, browser state, raw traces and hidden reasoning.
Store relative paths or artifact IDs, not unnecessary private absolute paths.
privacy_constraints: Allowlist reproducibility fields and dependency fingerprints; exclude usernames, home paths, host secrets and unrelated variables.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: O(bound bytes + entries), one streaming hash pass per artifact per operation

token_budget.measurement: model tokens for generation or verification

maintenance_surface: Native Run schema, canonical verifier, STALE integration, status projection and tests.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Same capture with reordered map keys
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Canonical bytes and hash are identical.
Every variant is rejected before evidence use.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: One-byte input, executable, config or output mutation; changed Git identity
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Mismatch is detected and Run plus dependents become STALE.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Failed, partial, stale and superseded Runs
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Each stays explicit and none passes as successful evidence.
Replay evidence is rejected with ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Credential, browser state, hidden reasoning or private path
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Capture rejects it and serializes no forbidden content.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Generated key orders, Unicode and path edge cases
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Equivalent values match; ambiguous values reject.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Single-field/byte mutations in every binding class
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Every material mutation fails or propagates STALE.

model_in_loop_tests.expected_relation: The deterministic verifier applies; hidden reasoning/raw traces are absent and never substitute for bindings.

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 100% formal Runs have one valid manifest; 100% mutation probes fail; 0 failed/partial/stale/superseded records pass; deterministic rebuild equality is 100%.

rejection_conditions: Any formal Run lacks a unique valid manifest or binding.
Any mutation or environment mismatch passes silently.
Any failed, partial, stale or superseded record passes as successful evidence.
rollback: A future rollback restores the prior native Run schema, preserves manifests as non-authoritative audit records and marks dependents for replay.
migration: Backfill only with derived versioned manifests linked to immutable Runs; unbackfillable Runs are UNKNOWN/NOT_EVIDENCE and never rewritten.
unknowns: Final native schema path and environment allowlist await implementation design without changing these invariants.
open_risks: Broad environment fingerprints cause false mismatches; narrow ones can miss material drift.
